text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for traffic calming (speed humps) on Greenwood Avenue, between O'Connor Drive and Plains Road. The assessment indicates the warrant criteria as set out in the City of Toronto's Traffic Calming Policy has not been satisfied. Therefore, staff do not recommend the installation of speed humps on Greenwood Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Greenwood Avenue. 2. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Greenwood Avenue, between O'Connor Drive and Plains Road. 3. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway to install three speed humps on Greenwood Avenue, between O'Connor Drive and Plains Road, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on Drawing No. 421G-4224, dated September 2022 and attached as Attachment 2 to the report (January 10, 2023) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
